lines.en: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of Halloween, it was two months until Christmas, it was a tried and true formulaic approach to an intro, it was contrived and boring and lame.
And also it was Friday. And you’ve gotta get down on Friday. So buckle up your wizard hat and lace up your glasses because we’re about to go for one wild ride!
Or maybe two wild rides.
Or maybe three or maybe four or maybe five wild rides because no one ever knows what’s going to happen next in Kumon-mi! But there are a few things we do know for sure.
First — somebody’s gonna get wienered.
Second — somebody’s gonna cry (maybe from getting wienered).
And third — entities above and below and off to the side will be watching our your every move; GOD God is watching to make sure your steps are stepped correctly.

Wizard hat. Glasses. You’re almost ready to go! A brand new destiny awaits you, passenger! And an older one awaits several others. But that’s a story for another day! One with fewer pumpkins/more trees.
Our event chain begins in another tried and true and formulaic and boring and contrived and lame manner with Imani Imai (substitute) briefing the class before some other guy debriefs them (sex joke).
What Imani Imai did not know, however, was that this Halloween wasn’t going to be like the other Halloweens. A thing was going to happen.

But not like the kind of thing where she accidentally fucks somebody and then they disappear because switching protagonists at this point in the race would make things really messy. No, a different thing.
She probably wouldn’t have to worry about that though since she hasn’t really been intrinsically linked to any of the meta-plot stuff yet. But others have!
And they’re just about buckled into their carts, so get in beside them and wait for your ride(s) to begin!
Oh, and remember — seeing is believing. Hearing is not.
The new word of the day is coaster! Getting ready to fall! With handlebar hands and iron legs, we ride! Together to the sunset! Together to the new world! Or the old one! Whichever COMES fiRST!?
: Okay! So if no one has any questions-
: I have a question!
: No, Kirin. I will not make out with you.
: Tch.
: I also have a question, Miss Imai.
: I won’t make out with you either, Touka. I don’t care how much you’re willing to pay.
: Wh...What? No. I’d just like to inquire about the situation with the “sad family” as you’ve written on the board.
: Were you not paying attention  earlier? That’s in reference to the Arakawas since Senpai and Ami are both going to-
: Y-Yes! I’m aware of...who it’s in reference to. But are we certain that Ami’s reintroduction to the class is safe given the...nature of departure?
: Well...no. But Senpai’s promised to keep her on a short leash.
: Either way though, Ami had a lot going on back then and I’d appreciate it if you girls could at least try and welcome her back since she’ll be returning to class next Monday.
: Does that mean the Supreme Overlord will be making a comeback as well?!
: You can ask him yourself once you get to Ayane’s place. He and some of the others are probably heading over there as we speak. All I’ve gotten confirmation on is Ami.
: So, if there’s nothing else-
: I have something!
: No, Chika. I will not-
: I just wanted to say that you’re looking extra young and awesome today, Imani. That’s all!
: You’re damn right, Chika! And thank you for following rule five! Ten points to the first floor for the next Dorm Wars!
: Ten?! But we normally only score like five total!
: Then I guess that just means you’ll all have to line up and start paying your tributes to me as well! Class dismissed!
: Miss Imai? Do you have a second?
: Hey, Futaba. Here to praise me? Take as long as you need. I don’t mind at all.
: Yes, you’re very youthful and beautiful. But that’s not what I wanted to talk about.
: Okay. But if it’s a complaint about truth or dare being banned, you’re going to have to fill out a form and wait for me to get back to you after I review the other fifty.
: I was just wondering if...you heard anything from my parents yet.
: They still haven’t called you?
: I’m...sure it’s fine! I just can’t help but worry since they’ve never...lost contact for so long before.
: I’m sorry, Futaba. I haven’t heard anything. But I can try contacting them again over the weekend if-
: No! No, it’s fine. I’ll just...keep trying. You don’t have to worry about it.
: If you say so...But in the meantime, if you need anyone to talk to-
: I have you. I know. Thank you, Miss Imai.
: That really...means a lot to me.
: Why will my bangs not cooperate with me today? Have I done something to wrong them? Is this because I switched to Aussie? Has TikTok deceived me once more?
: They look the same as always, Uta.
: The same as always?! They’re not supposed to look the same as always! I put a little gap here! There’s not normally a gap! But the gap keeps closing! I’m freaking out, Io!
: Sorry, let me start over. What exactly are you trying to do that...isn’t working?
: Ugh, I don’t even know! Just nothing I do is making me feel pretty today and I’m like two steps away from just shaving my head and becoming a monk.
: Who cares if you’re not feeling pretty?
: Me, obviously. This costume needs to be a total knockout. Sensei’s a millennial, Io. And do you know what millennials like? Final Fantasy VII.
: Is that...a fact?
: That and affordable student loans, yeah. And I’m not about to dress up as a friggin’ bank teller for Halloween. I want him to look at me more this year.
: So you just...chose to dress up as a character you know nothing about for the sole purpose of impressing the boy you like?
: Please don’t make me feel any more pathetic than I already do, Io. I’m already down bad.
: I don’t want you to feel pathetic, Uta. I think that’s...really cute. In a...depressingly gross pandering sort of way that does nothing to accentuate any of your best qualities.
: This friggin’ push-up bra better be accentuating my best qualities or Shein is going to have hell to pay once Halloween is over.
: I just meant that I think you’re at your best when you’re you. Not Tifa Lockhart.
: That’s very sweet of you. You are wrong.
: Oh. My bad.
: It’s okay. I forgive you. Now, please excuse me as I continue to have an identity crisis — which you are probably already very familiar with.
: Yeah, that’s fine. I’ll just sit here and go back to literally being a crisis until you’re ready to talk about stuff that isn’t boring anymore.
: Thank you. Cuteness: loading. Please wait.
: Io, hold my mirror and aim it at my face. I’m going to try something.
: Yes, my queen. Anything to help you shrink yourself for the sole purpose of sexually appealing to a man.
: Now you’re getting it, Io.
: Hey, uhh...did Imani get rid of rule two? Because I no longer feel safe in this environment.
: You’re literally not wearing pants right now.
: Fine by me. Gives me easier access once it’s my turn to be crushed on by Rin.
: Hands off, slut. I’d never let Rin settle for the likes of you.
: And yes, I am gate-keeping her. And there is nothing you can do about it.

: Oh, Chika. If only you knew what Rin and I have already been through together. She and I have the type of bond that can’t be forged by...wait, what forged your bond again? That time you rejected her?
: Kirin...
: I would never reject you, Rin. In fact, why don’t the two of us-
: No thanks.
: Really?! Just like that?!
: Pfffft! Amazing!

: Yeah, I prefer Nico over Nami. And Perona. And Vivi. And Boa. And pretty much every other girl in One Piece. Some of the guys too. Your boobs are also way too small for all of her post-timeskip costumes.
: They’ll grow! Just look at Karin!
: I do. Sometimes too much.
: I liked this class more when Molly was the punching bag, not me.
: Well, stop putting your thong on display for everyone to see and maybe fewer people will call you out for  your sluttiness. Rin, are we still going to the party together?
: Yeah — but do you mind if Futaba comes too? She’s not feeling great because of the whole thing with her parents.
: Aww...poor thing. Of course she can come. I don’t mind at all.
: Can I come too? Noriko and Miku both went over early to set things up and-
: No.
: That was quick.
: It was an easy decision.
: Wow. I never realized how much you two dislike each other.
: Chika doesn’t actually hate me. We secretly want to fuck each other and this is just how we flirt.
: No, I actually hate you.
: Oh.
: Well, shit.
: I will concede that you are sometimes kind of hot, though. Kind of. Don’t let it go to your head.
: It’s already there. Hearing that is actually better than hearing you like me since it opens up the possibility of a threesome.
: Not a fucking-
: Actually...
: Wait, ew. No. Not in a million years. Why did I even hesitate?
: Rin, come on. I need to stop back at the dorms first. We can take a taxi from there.
: So am I-
: Not invited! Sorry! Just not really!
: Ughhhhh Rin? Can’t you reason with her? Didn’t our passionate mechanical double-date mean anything to-
: No thanks.
: Stop rejecting me so quickly! I have pride, you know!
: ...and that’s why I hate working with latex!
: I lost track of how many times the Emerald Guardian needed to lubricate my body in order to get this costume to properly fit.
: Yup! It was totally unenjoyable and I absolutely hated the fact that I had to do that so many times!
: I am...quite surprised you’re even open to wearing something that revealing, Tsuneyo. I’m beginning to believe what you said about being an exhibitionist might actually be true.
: It’s not a crime to-
: Wait...exhibitionist? You? The Kendo Princess?
: You haven’t been using my PC, have you? Because if I left any tabs open, they were definitely just pop-ups. I have a virus. Many viruses. Don’t ever look at my PC under any circumstances.
: A true exhibitionist does not reveal her exhibitions. I am an enigma. There can be no truth to discover about me, for there is no truth at all. I am but a Rubik’s Cube, bro. Deal with it.
: Rubik’s Cubes can be solved rather simply, actually. My record is seventy-four seconds.
: Do you think you are better than me?
: Don’t be intimidated by her just because she could separate your head from your body in three seconds flat. The Kendo Princess just isn’t very good at puzzles.
: Prepare to die, Thursday Smith.
: Wednesday Addams.
: Monday Jones.
: I have finished praying. I am ready to be engulfed by spirits.
: And you made it all the way over here without me having to come get you! I’m so very proud, Yasu!
: Thank you, Touka. I apologize for being such a burden every second of every day.
: I know the Emerald Guardian’s craftsmanship when I see it. Those fabrics were splayed out across our bedroom floor mere weeks ago. Return them now or face my blade.
: Cease, Ram. Yasu’s merely wearing what I asked her to as I thought she’d make an excellent Frieren, but...something seems off.
: You are correct, Emerald Guardian. I can see several areas where you’ve made errors in stitching.
: No I meant with-
: Wait, where?! Near the collar? But I-
: Before you...fall into the rabbit hole of inspecting your hard work, I believe I know what you’re referring to. And I can assure you it’s no problem at all.
: Really? Then...is she just tired or something? She seemed so excited the last time she tried on the costume and now she’s barely a step above undead.
: Yasu, why don’t you tell Molly what’s really going on? You can handle that, right?
: The Tsukioka family has graciously provided the resources I need to heal. For the first time, I am present. I am here. I am Yasu Yasui. I am a normal girl.
: Very well done, Yasu!
: Thank you, Touka.
: Yeah, I don’t like this.
: Oh, thank goodness. I was worried it was just me.
: While getting Yasu psychiatric help was of utmost importance to my family and me, I can’t help but second-guess our actions now that I’ve seen what medication has done to the poor girl.
: I’m sorry, Touka. Nothing I do will ever be good enough for you or anyone else.
: Of all the qualities to keep, why’d it have to be the self-loathing?
: I don’t know, but I’ll be speaking to my mother shortly since this is just...not the Yasu I know.
: But how does she feel about it?
: Yasu...do you understand the question? Do you feel any different now that you’re not...your former self anymore?
: I have never been anything. I will never be anything. I am a bug. That is all.
: Yeah...I think you should probably talk to your mom.
: Nodoka? Are you-
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!
: Oh, okay. I guess not much has changed then.
: Nothing’s changed at all! No matter what I do, I keep ending up exactly where I started! Nothing makes sense! It’s all fucking wrong!
: Sooooo...no Halloween party then?
: Fuck Halloween! You think I can afford making time to masturbate with so many secrets slipping through my fingers?! They’ll get stuck inside me, damn it! Then I’ll never get them out!
: Nodoka, you’ve been at it for days. You need to take a break or you’re literally going to die and then no one will ever figure out the “secrets of the universe.”
: Take a break?! Now?! You think I can just turn this shit off?! Fuck you! You know what you’d do if I asked you to take a break while you’re working?! You’d fuck me! That’s what!
: That is more assuredly not a thing I would ever do no matter how engrossed in work I am.
: Pussy! I could make you cum harder than anyone and you know it! Slut! Bitch! Shut up! Go away!
: Listen — if you’re not going to come to the party, that’s fine. I’ll find someone else to chill with there. But you’ve gotta fucking rest, Nodoka. I’m worried about you.
: Well, worry about something else! Do you have any idea what percentage of koalas have chlamydia?! It’s an alarming percentage, Otoha! Worry about that! I’m busy!
: Nodoka-
: I SAID I’M FUCKING BUSY! STOP CALLING!
: Your mom wouldn’t want this.
: I know that, you fucking moron!
: That’s why I have to do it.
: I’ll call you later, okay?
: Don’t! Go fuck someone! Get pregnant and have a son and then fuck your son! Then after he gets you pregnant, you can call me! That’s when I’ll be free! Not a minute before then!
: Okay. So like three or four hours?
: YOU FUCKING- AAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH! YOU DON’T EVEN REALIZE THE IMPLICATIONS OF WHAT YOU JUST SAID, DO YOU?! DON’T EVER SPEAK OF HOURS OR TIME AT ALL AGAIN! FUCK YOU! BYE!
: Later, Nodoka...
: Be careful.
